title: The Nine instruct building a copper Faraday cage for clearer transmission

tellings.quote: you know okay, look, you're contacting us through a psychic, but if you want a clearer feed, a a clearer transmission, you have to put the psychic in a Faraday cage.

plain: In the 1950s, at the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine, a set of beings calling themselves the Nine, who were said to speak through a psychic, reportedly told the researchers that for a clearer signal they should put the psychic inside a copper Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks outside electrical interference. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells it from the group's own tape recordings, summing up the message as: "if you want a clearer feed, a clearer transmission, you have to put the psychic in a Faraday cage." If true, it would mean the supposed contacts were giving practical, technical instructions.
